name: Contrast Stretch
description: Adaptive contrast. It measures the scene's darkest and brightest levels, eases the measurement over time, stretches them towards black and white, then shapes the dark, mid and light zones with a gain each.

params.label: Black stretch
params.doc: How much of the scene's darkest level is stretched down to black; 0 leaves blacks alone, 1 stretches fully.

params.label: White stretch
params.doc: How much of the scene's brightest level is stretched up to white; 0 leaves whites alone, 1 stretches fully.

params.label: Dark zone end
params.doc: The brightness where the dark zone fades out; 0 turns the dark zone off.

params.label: Dark zone level
params.doc: The level the dark zone's curve is set at, with Dark zone result giving what it becomes.

params.label: Dark zone result
params.doc: What the dark zone's level becomes; below the level darkens the zone, above it brightens.

params.label: Mid zone level
params.doc: The level the mid zone's curve is set at, with Mid zone result giving what it becomes.

params.label: Mid zone result
params.doc: What the mid zone's level becomes; below the level darkens the midtones, above it brightens them.

params.label: Light zone start
params.doc: The brightness where the light zone fades in; 0 turns the light zone off.

params.label: Light zone level
params.doc: The level the light zone's curve is set at, with Light zone result giving what it becomes.

params.label: Light zone result
params.doc: What the light zone's level becomes; below the level darkens the highlights, above it brightens them.

params.label: Adaptation speed
params.doc: The most the measured black and white may move per second, so the stretch eases in as the scene changes.
